hooks.name: Run pytest when core scoring code changes
hooks.description: Runs the scoring, state, needle and property tests whenever scoring.py, state.py or needle.py is saved.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && . .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; pytest -q tests/test_scoring.py tests/test_state.py tests/test_needle.py tests/test_properties.py
